name: Dr. Aarav Chen
talkTitle: Beyond Silicon: Mapping the Subatomic Mind
description: Pioneering the intersection of quantum entanglement and synthetic neural pathways to redefine how machines compute thought.
quote: When we stop treating quantum physics as a paradox and start treating it as architecture, consciousness becomes measurable.

name: Maya Varma
talkTitle: Living Structures: Architecture That Grows and Heals
description: Synthesizing mycelium composites and bioluminescent algae to construct self-healing urban ecosystems that breathe with the earth.
quote: The future of construction isn't concrete and steel—it is genetic code and cellular regeneration.

name: Vikramaditya Roy
talkTitle: Catching Photons: Sailing Across the Solar Abyss
description: Leading the next frontier in relativistic laser-driven lightsails to propel humanity's reach beyond our planetary cradle within a generation.
quote: Distance in the cosmos is not a barrier; it is simply an engineering equation waiting for courage.

name: Elena Rostova
talkTitle: The Echo of Millennia: Decoding Ancient Acoustic Resonances
description: Restoring the acoustic soundscapes of lost civilizations using spatial impulse modeling and AI-assisted harmonic reconstruction.
quote: Sound does not die; it embeds itself into stone, atmosphere, and time. We are only learning to listen.

name: Kiran Deshmukh
talkTitle: Bottling Stars: The Final Metric for Abundance
description: Overcoming magnetic confinement instability to deliver limitless, democratized clean energy for human civilization.
quote: Abundance is not a luxury; it is the fundamental prerequisite for human enlightenment.

name: Sofia Al-Mansoor
talkTitle: The Geometry of Autonomy: Who Owns Your Next Choice?
description: Investigating how subconscious predictive models reshape free will, and crafting the legislative guardrails for human cognition.
quote: Freedom in the 21st century will not be fought on borders, but within the latent spaces of our own attention.

name: Tariq Thorne
talkTitle: Sensory Expansion: Feeling Colors and Hearing Light
description: Designing high-bandwidth neural interfaces that restore lost motor functions while unlocking synthetic sixth and seventh senses.
quote: We are not replacing what was lost. We are exploring the uncharted canvas of human perception.

name: Ananya Sen
talkTitle: Harvesting the Clouds: Micro-Condensation in Hyper-Arid Zones
description: Developing biomimetic fog nets and solar atmospheric water extractors to bring agricultural sovereignty to desert frontiers.
quote: Water is everywhere around us—invisible in the air. All it takes is the right surface to call it home.
